result.title: Evolving Creatives with Clicks: CTR-Driven Advertising image Editing via Attribute Disentanglement and Preference Alignment
result.summary: The optimization objective for e-commerce advertising creatives has shifted from aesthetic quality to online business metrics like click-through rate (CTR). Recent methods generate appealing ad images from product images by constructing CTR-based reward signals and refining prompt generation via Reinforcement Learning. Such paradigms equally penalize all attributes within an underperforming image, even though some are actually beneficial to clicks. In this work, we propose Evolving Creatives with Clicks (ECC), which reformulates creative optimization as fine-grained editing rather than generation from scratch. ECC selectively refines attributes that hurt CTR while preserving those that contribute positively. Specifically, faced with a rich attribute space across massive images, ECC first identifies 28 attributes significantly correlated with CTR via ANOVA and Random Forest regression. Based on attribute contrasts between images with disparate CTRs, we instruction-tune a prompt model to generate editing suggestions, then refine it with real click preferences since reference-derived suggestions are not uniformly beneficial. Furthermore, we introduce Consistent Preference Optimization (CPO) as ECC's preference optimization strategy, which enforces consistency across semantically equivalent shuffled suggestions to mitigate DPO overfitting and improve preference generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ECC significantly improves the CTR of ad images, outperforming state-of-the-art models by a substantial margin. The complete data pipeline, including attribute extraction and analysis, the resulting dataset, and source code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ECC，把电商广告图优化重构为细粒度属性编辑：先用 ANOVA 与随机森林筛出 28 个与 CTR 显著相关的属性，依据高低 CTR 图像的属性差异做指令微调并生成编辑建议，再用真实点击偏好对齐，并提出 CPO 在语义等价重排建议上强制一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只修正有害属性、保留有益属性」的细粒度信用分配，以及 CPO 对语义等价输入的一致性约束，可能为 LVR 中 latent 步骤的贡献分配与偏好/轨迹监督提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身属图像编辑应用，与研究主线无直接关联。
